name: Car Flag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality polyester fiber fabric, offering a lightweight, durable, and weather-resistant finish for outdoor display.
    - Designed for vehicle use with a sturdy pole and secure retaining clip for stable attachment.
    - The fabric is lightweight enough to wave naturally while driving, yet durable enough for regular use.
    - Includes a stable retaining clip to help keep the flag in place during movement.
    - Suitable for patriotic themes, celebration events, holiday parades, sports support, and custom car decoration.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Flag size: 18 x 12 in ~ 45.72 x 30.48 cm
    - Total pole height: 44 cm ~ 17.32 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design. Size may vary by 1–3 cm, which is considered normal.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using Sublimation Printing technology for vibrant colors, sharp details, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Double-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a car decoration flag and a celebratory display accessory.
    - Designed to attach securely to vehicle windows using the included pole and retaining clip.
    - Suitable for national holidays, parades, patriotic celebrations, sporting events, campaigns, and festive occasions.
    - Lightweight construction allows the flag to move naturally while the clip helps keep it stable.
    - Great for cars, event caravans, outdoor celebrations, and decorative vehicle styling.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A great decorative item for drivers, families, event participants, sports fans, and patriotic celebration lovers.
    - Perfect for Independence Day, national celebrations, parades, party events, car rallies, and festive gatherings.
    - Ideal for anyone who wants to add a bold and spirited touch to their vehicle.
    - Great for holiday décor, celebration accessories, and themed event displays.
    - A fun and practical accessory that adds energy and visual impact to any occasion.
    - Brings a festive, patriotic, and eye-catching touch to your car 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Car Flag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
